data.desc: Through its operating subsidiaries, MKDWELL manufactures and supplies automotive electronics for passenger cars, modified commercial vehicles, camper vans and logistics vehicles. Its business covers research and development, design, production and sales, with a focus on intelligent control systems and LiDAR sensors. Through its operating subsidiaries, the Company also conducts smart-home and Internet-of-Things (IoT) product businesses and provides OEM and ODM solutions for international brand and retail customers. The Company's operations span Taiwan, mainland China and Hong Kong.
